GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-09-01T08:09:40Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Check if an error is caused by a Renderer
Description: In version 2.15.0 the **onPlayerError** signature has changed from:

`public void onPlayerError(ExoPlaybackException error)`

to:

`public void onPlayerError(PlaybackException error)`

With the older signature we could check if the error was caused by a renderer by querying the error type:

`if (error.type == ExoPlaybackException.TYPE_RENDERER)`

How can now be checked with **PlaybackException**? There is no equivalent in **PlaybackException.errorCode**

CATEGORY: [category number]
REASONING: [your reasoning here, including specific reasons why an issue would be hard to dockerize if choosing category 3]
